Creating list of Region_objects

Source: R/Loader.R
create_region_list.Rd

Function for creating a list of Region_objects from a region-mapping data frame. In most workflows this is called automatically by create_projection_object; call it directly only when you need to customise the region list before assembling a projection.

Usage

create_region_list(region_data = base_data_list[[11]])

Arguments

region_data

Data frame; mapping region names to region identifiers. See data_regions. Defaults to the regions table stored in base_data_list (base_data_list[[11]]).

Value

List of Region_objects, one per row in region_data.

See also

create_projection_object which calls this automatically, base_data_list for the default region mapping data.

Examples

create_region_list(region_data = base_data_list[[11]])
